      "observations": [
        "The owned gate calls getAutocryptGossip only when gSendEncrypted, this.sendPgpMime and gCurrentIdentity.sendAutocryptHeaders are all true; otherwise it supplies an empty string. The same gate remains at the accepted revision. The independent identity preference is part of the condition, not merely a consequence of signing.",
        "The accepted generator deduplicates To/Cc plus optional Reply-To, removes the sender, returns an empty string for fewer than two recipients and skips unavailable keys. prepareSecurityInfo forwards its result, and the MIME writer appends supplied gossip. These are distinct producer, gate and consumer roles.",
        "The added signed-only assertion checks !src.includes(\"Autocrypt-Gossip:\") with a nonempty should message. Alice and Carol are both imported as public keys, and the modified test supplies both recipients; this avoids a one-recipient empty-gossip path that would mask the regression.",
        "All changed test hunks are read. The current sendMessage helper waits for compose closure plus a timer turn, so source inspection alone establishes neither successful delivery nor a fresh cryptographic result. The focused change has no missing assertion message; unrelated later header-protection assertions are separate phases.",
        "The multiline conjunction and conditional expression keep the three independent gates visible. The comment describes the concrete multiple-recipient state that makes the assertion meaningful.",
        "Complete primary 2019026 raises unintended gossip in signed-only messages and the independent identity preference. Its specification citation remains private context; no external standard body was read.",
        "In D284711 the reviewer requests a regression test and a colon in the searched header name. The author first reports adding a test, then explicitly corrects that it did not fail without the fix and adds a second recipient. The owned source adopts both the colon and the second-recipient setup. Review acceptance and the corrected historical test report are distinct from fresh execution."
